summary: Move inline cleanup DELETEs in grant-editor.test.ts from it() bodies to afterAll() hooks so leaked grant rows no longer accumulate in DEV_ROLE_OWNER mgmt_object:* on assertion failure, and add a one-shot idempotent sanitation script for the already-contaminated live dev silo.
functional: FR-1: Each of the five contaminating describe blocks in grant-editor.test.ts (AC-01, AC-07, AC-14, AC-20, FF-10) must declare a describe-scoped let variable for the inserted grant ID, assign it before the first expect() on the insert result, and DELETE the row in an afterAll() using migratorUrl().
FR-2: The afterAll DELETE is WHERE id=$id; it is a no-op if the row was already removed by an earlier inline DELETE. Both running is harmless.

FR-3: The FF-10 live test must extract the HTTP-created grantId from the server response before any expect() assertion runs, storing it into the describe-scoped let variable so the afterAll can reach it even if assertions throw.
FR-4: ADV-3 in grant-editor.adversarial.test.ts already uses afterAll correctly; it must not be modified.
FR-5: No expect() assertions are removed, changed, or silently caught.

FR-6: A script scripts/cleanup-test-grants.ts is added that DELETEs from choros."grant" all rows with role_id=DEV_ROLE_OWNER, resource_type LIKE 'mgmt_object:%', and granted_by IN ('test', 'd0000000-0000-0000-0000-0000000000ff') (the two known test-actor markers), prints the deleted count, and exits 0. Running it twice deletes 0 rows on the second run (idempotent). It does NOT touch rows with granted_by='seed'.
FR-7: No files under db/migrations/ are changed.
non_functional: NF-1: No new package.json dependencies; the cleanup script uses the existing pg package.
NF-2: Two consecutive runs of npm run fitness:db against a freshly seeded DB leave the grant row counts for DEV_ROLE_OWNER + mgmt_object:* unchanged (= 17) after each run.
NF-3: ADV-1 and ADV-2 count-before/count-after probes on choros."grant" remain unaffected; no ordering dependency is introduced between their cleanups and the newly moved cleanups.
out_of_scope: Fixing test isolation for DEV_ROLE_BUDGET inserts (ADV-1, ADV-2 are already safe).
Wrapping tests in DB transactions or savepoints.
Fixing contamination in role_assignment or any table other than choros."grant".
Addressing db-tier flakiness sources beyond the inline-cleanup accumulation pattern.

acceptance_criteria.text: Two consecutive complete runs of npm run fitness:db (no DB reset between runs) against a freshly seeded dev silo both produce COUNT(choros."grant" WHERE role_id=DEV_ROLE_OWNER AND resource_type LIKE 'mgmt_object:%') = 17. genesis-owner-seed.test.ts is green both times.
genesis-owner-seed.test.ts is green on a freshly seeded silo after an arbitrary number of npm run fitness:db runs. The exactly-17 assertion never fails due to leaked test rows.

All assertions in grant-editor.test.ts and grant-editor.adversarial.test.ts that were passing before T-0144 remain present and passing after T-0144. No expect() call is removed or guarded with a try/catch that would suppress a failure.

In the FF-10 live describe block, the variable holding the HTTP-created grant ID is declared at describe scope and assigned before the first expect() on the HTTP response. The afterAll uses this variable to DELETE the row.

Running npx tsx scripts/cleanup-test-grants.ts with DATABASE_URL pointing to a contaminated silo deletes all rows matching the test-actor markers, prints the count, exits 0, and is idempotent (second run deletes 0 rows).
git diff dev -- db/migrations/ is empty after T-0144 is applied: no migration files are added or modified.
